EchoGarden 0.3.1

Cyan

Multi-line echoes with diffusion/reverb around the repeats.

Knobs

Panel knob Function
1 Warp Echo spacing: tight → roughly 1× / 1.33× / 1.67× / 2×
2 Time Base echo time, about 15 ms–1.8 s
3 Blur Reverb/diffusion depth
4 Reflect Feedback, up to about 96% normally
5 Mix Dry/wet
6 Atmosphere Select 1–4 active echo lines

Buttons and gates

Control Function / active LED
8 Freeze Latch held feedback; removes new input / yellow
7 Reverse Latch ping-pong/cross-feedback / green
9 Shift, held Bloom: more reverb and a longer tail
78 Reverse / Freeze gates Temporarily invert stored button states

Details & sources

  • Knob meter: Time/Blur blue, Reflect red, Mix/Warp yellow, Atmosphere green.
  • Starting point: Time 40%, Reflect 50%, Mix 60%, one line, Blur 10%, Warp low.
  • CV scaling/ranges: not specified.

Source: author-supplied EchoGarden v0.3.1 Parameter Manual.
